paragraphs.en: {Nowadays} , in many places around the world, kids play {soccer} less than before.One {cause} is that many kids are {busy} with their studies.Besides, many parents don't know soccer's {real} benefits to kids.In fact, soccer offers a wide range of physical, social, and emotional benefits, whether played in a {stadium} , a school {yard} or on a {square} .Here are some reasons why kids should play the beautiful {game} .
paragraphs.cn: <u> 如今 </u> ，在世界许多地方，孩子们踢 <u> 足球 </u> 的时间都比以前少了。其中一个 <u> 原因 </u> 是很多孩子 <u> 忙 </u> 于学业。此外，很多家长并不了解足球对孩子的 <u> 真正 </u> 益处。事实上，无论是在 <u> 体育场 </u> 、学校 <u> 操场 </u> 还是 <u> 广场 </u> 上踢球，足球都能给孩子们带来身体、社交和情感等多方面的益处。以下是孩子们应该参与这项美好 <u> 运动 </u> 的一些原因。
足球是一项团队 <u> 运动 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: {Teamwork} is a life skill that kids need to learn.A soccer team is like a well-organized ( (组织良好的) ) {package} of {players} , each with specific roles and responsibilities.Being part of a team isn't just about learning how to follow {strict} rules and share {talents} ; it's also about teaching kids the importance of {order} and how to face failure.It doesn't end {there} , either.By learning to rely on one another, children develop {empathy} and respect for their teammates, which are critical components of good cooperation.
paragraphs.cn: <u> 团队合作 </u> 是孩子们需要学习的一项生活技能。一支足球队就像一个组织良好的 <u> 球员组合 </u> ，每个球员都有特定的角色和职责。成为团队的一员不仅仅是学习如何遵守 <u> 严格的 </u> 规则并分享个人 <u> 才能 </u> ，还在于教会孩子们 <u> 秩序 </u> 的重要性，以及如何面对失败。而且，还不止于 <u> 此 </u> 。通过学习相互依靠，孩子们会对队友产生 <u> 同理心 </u> 和尊重，这些都是良好合作的关键要素。
足球塑造 <u> 运动 </u> 技能。

paragraphs.en: Nowadays, many kids prefer to stay in their rooms to have {fun} through {smartphones} .So they have less time {outdoors} for sports.Soccer is an {excellent} form of {PE} because it engages almost every muscle group.By playing youth soccer on the {court} , kids get a chance to develop their {physical} strength and motor skills.
paragraphs.cn: 如今，很多孩子更喜欢待在房间里，通过 <u> 智能手机娱乐 </u> 。因此，他们 <u> 在户外 </u> 运动的时间变少了。足球是一种 <u> 极佳的体育 </u> 运动形式，因为它几乎能锻炼到每一个肌肉群。通过在 <u> 球场 </u> 上参加青少年足球活动，孩子们有机会培养他们的 <u> 体 </u> 能和运动技能。

paragraphs.en: Soccer plays a part in school {performance} .
paragraphs.cn: 足球对学业 <u> 表现 </u> 有影响。

paragraphs.en: Soccer can improve students' concentration in the classroom.Besides, soccer is a fast-paced game, so kids can learn how to {solve} problems quickly.Plus, soccer is a sport which involves getting the ball from point A to point B.So kids' visual-spatial ( (视觉空间) ) ability can be improved when they play the game, which can help them learn subjects like {Physics} .
paragraphs.cn: 足球可以提高学生在课堂上的 <u> 注意力 </u> 。此外，足球是一项节奏很快的运动，所以孩子们可以学会如何快速 <u> 解决 </u> 问题。再者，足球是一项需要把球从A点传到B点的运动。因此，孩子们在踢球时可以提高视觉空间能力，这有助于他们学习 <u> 物理 </u> 等科目。

paragraphs.en: The World Health Organization {recommends} kids get at least 60 minutes of exercise daily. {Winning} a game or simply improving skills can give children a sense of accomplishment.When a child has to {kick} the ball past an {opponent} or {tackle} them, they also learn perseverance ( (坚持不懈) ) and resilience ( (适应力) ). {Usually} , kids who like sports such as soccer are more {outgoing} .They are better able to handle stress or {panic} in their lives and less likely to fall into {negative} habits like {abuse} of {alcohol} or drugs.
paragraphs.cn: 世界卫生 <u> 组织建议 </u> 儿童每天至少进行60分钟的运动。 <u> 赢得 </u> 比赛或仅仅是技能提升都能给孩子们带来成就感。当一个孩子必须将球 <u> 踢 </u> 过 <u> 对手 </u> 或 <u> 进行抢断 </u> 时，他们也学会了坚持不懈和坚韧不拔。 <u> 通常 </u> ，喜欢足球等运动的孩子都更加 <u> 外向 </u> 。他们能更好地应对生活中的压力或 <u> 恐慌 </u> ，而且不太可能染上 <u> 酗酒 </u> 或吸毒等 <u> 不良 </u> 的习惯。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
